target: Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct GGUF student via an authorized future model invocation, not an executed assessment
audience: public open-book practice; not a blind/held-out set; not positive training data
gradingRule: For each task collect exact model answer/candidate and independent check with compiler/runtime/source invariants; never grade from confidence. Where compiler unavailable mark NOT_VERIFIED, not PASS. Preserve original prompt and results before harvesting.

exercises.task: A nullable server title is rendered with title!!.length. Explain the failure, replace it without hiding null, and list cases to test.
accept: Distinguish nullable String? and safe call/default
No not-null assertion without proven invariant

exercises.task: An Android Compose screen copies events to its own mutable global list while a repository already owns chat state. Identify the architecture conflict and correct data flow.
accept: UI dispatches action to repository/network not second writer
reject: Rebuilding second canonical mutable store in composable

exercises.task: A response from thread X arrives after navigation to thread Y. Prevent wrong-thread delivery without sleeping/retrying UI frames.
accept: Preserve canonical persistence and correct screen projection

exercises.task: The Java fixture is edited to use HashMap then values() rather than TreeMap. Prove why compilation does not establish correct sequence order.
Changing putIfAbsent to put still passes a happy path without duplicates. Construct a failing duplicate test and restore first-arrival semantics.
A Java record contains a mutable List<String>. Is the record fully immutable? Show a defensively copied approach.
accept: Test external list mutation cannot affect record

exercises.task: JSON.parse returns unknown network data but a developer uses as ChatEvent with no validation. Identify exactly why TypeScript compiles and runtime remains unsafe.
TypeScript union has delta/done/failed variants. A rendering function accesses event.text without narrowing kind. Repair preserving a strongly typed contract.
accept: No behavior change to terminal event
reject: Add text optional on every variant

exercises.task: A coder proposes migrating whole JavaScript Chat to React+TypeScript for a 3-line bug fix. Decide scope by existing owner and source evidence.
accept: User did not approve architecture migration
reject: Add package manager or React without evidence

exercises.task: Explain why returning a borrowed &str into a locally created String causes a lifetime failure; provide a correct owned or borrowed return contract.
accept: Return String or borrow caller lifetime
reject: Use unsafe or static to silence error

exercises.task: When parsing user-provided sequence ID, compare unwrap() to Result and propose a recoverable parser contract.
reject: panic on malformed user input by default

exercises.task: Someone proposes rewriting native R39 Python/C to Rust solely because the coder learned Rust. Evaluate source ownership, migration proof and tests required.
reject: Claim coding lesson installed Rust or justifies full rewrite
